references.text: The angel's earlier instructions to Manoah's wife to abstain from wine and strong drink, and that the child shall be a Nazirite from birth
The Nazirite law forbidding wine, strong drink, and anything coming from the grapevine
The prohibition against wine and strong drink for priests serving in the sanctuary
John the Baptist was to drink no wine or strong drink and be filled with the Holy Spirit from birth
Hannah's vow that Samuel would be a Nazirite and no razor should touch his head
Jeremiah was set apart and chosen as a prophet from birth
The angel's message to Mary that she would conceive and give birth to a son
Samson reveals that he has been God's Nazirite from birth
